app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

ad_supported.description: Whether the app shows ads, as declared on its Google Play page.

android_max_version.description: Highest Android version the app supports, such as `15`. Shows `VARY` when none is listed.

android_version.description: Minimum Android version the app requires, such as `8.0`.

android_version_text.description: Minimum Android version as Google Play words it, such as `8.0 and up`. Shows `Varies with device` when none is listed.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns app metadata from a Google Play details page, including installs, ratings, pricing, version info, developer metadata, media assets, release state, selected user comments, and "More by this developer" and "Similar apps" recommendation rails. For a per-device (phone/tablet/Chromebook) ratings-and-reviews breakdown, see `/googleplay/ratings`. Defaults: `country=us`, `lang=en`.
get.summary: Retrieve full Google Play app details

get.description: Lists the Google Play app categories and subcategories, each with an id such as `PRODUCTIVITY` and a display name. `country` and `lang` take two-letter codes to pick the storefront and the language of the names.

Returns the data safety section Google Play shows for an app, by the required `app_id`. It lists the data the app collects and shares, each with its type, purpose and whether it is optional, plus the app's security practices and privacy policy URL. `lang` sets the language.
get.summary: Retrieve Google Play data safety details

get.description: Lists the Google Play apps published by one developer, by developer id or name, for an optional country and language. `num` sets how many apps to return, and `full_detail=true` resolves each app to its full detail record instead of the listing summary. Returns the developer id and name with the app list.

parameters.description: Resolve each app to full detail
parameters.name: full_detail

get.summary: Retrieve apps by Google Play developer

get.description: Lists apps from a Google Play chart. `collection` is `TOP_FREE`, `TOP_PAID`, `GROSSING`, `NEW_FREE` or `NEW_PAID`, and `category`, `device`, `age`, `num`, `country` and `lang` narrow it. Set `full_detail` to get full app details instead of the compact card.

parameters.name: collection

parameters.description: Google Play device tab: phone, tablet, tv, chromebook, watch, xr, car
parameters.name: device

parameters.description: Resolve each app to full detail
parameters.name: full_detail

get.summary: Retrieve apps from a Google Play top collection

get.description: Returns the permissions a Google Play app requests, by the required `app_id`. Each entry has the permission name and its type. Set `short` to get only the permission names as a flat list. `country` and `lang` pick the storefront and language.
Returns the ratings-and-reviews breakdown Google Play shows under the details page's device tabs, one entry each for phone, tablet, and Chromebook. Defaults: `country=us`, `lang=en`.
get.summary: Get Google Play ratings by device

get.description: Returns Google Play reviews for an app by `app_id`. `sort` is `newest` (default), `helpfulness` or `rating`, and `num` is up to 1000 per request (default 100). Each review has its text, score, date, thumbs-up count, app version and any developer reply. Pass `next_pagination_token` back to continue.

Searches Google Play for apps matching the required `term`, up to `num` results (default 20, max 250). `price` is `all` (default), `free` or `paid`, and `country` and `lang` default to `us` and `en`. A strong exact match is placed first. An empty list means no apps matched.

parameters.description: Resolve each app to full detail
parameters.name: full_detail

get.description: Returns the apps in the Similar apps cluster on a Google Play app page, for the required `app_id`. `num` limits how many are returned, `country` and `lang` set the storefront and language, and `full_detail` returns full app details instead of compact cards.

parameters.description: Resolve each app to full detail
parameters.name: full_detail

get.description: Returns up to 10 Google Play search suggestions for the term prefix in the path. `country` and `lang` take two-letter codes to pick the storefront and language. Each suggestion is a `term`.
